# graylog_event_notification_types (Data Source)

Lists Graylog event notification types and configuration fields. Includes built-in modern types (`http-notification-v1`, `email-notification-v1`, …) plus legacy alarm callback types from `/events/notifications/legacy/types`. Use this when configuring `graylog_event_notification.config`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graylog_event_notification_types" "available" {}

output "http_notification_fields" {
  value = [
    for t in data.graylog_event_notification_types.available.types : [
      for f in t.requested_configuration : "${f.name} (optional=${f.is_optional})"
    ]
    if t.type == "http-notification-v1"
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `types` (Attributes List) Available event notification types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--types))

<a id="nestedatt--types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `types`

Read-Only:

- `default_config` (String) JSON-encoded default configuration object when Graylog provides one.
- `description` (String) Optional description from Graylog.
- `link_to_docs` (String) Optional documentation URL from Graylog.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the type.
- `requested_configuration` (Attributes List) Configuration fields for this type (name, optional/required, defaults, descriptions). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--types--requested_configuration))
- `type` (String) Type identifier (short alias when known, otherwise Graylog's native type string).

<a id="nestedatt--types--requested_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `types.requested_configuration`

Read-Only:

- `additional_info` (String) JSON-encoded additional field metadata (e.g. dropdown values).
- `attributes` (List of String) Graylog field attributes (e.g. textarea).
- `default_value` (String) JSON-encoded default value, if any.
- `description` (String) Field help text from Graylog.
- `human_name` (String) UI label for the field.
- `is_optional` (Boolean) Whether Graylog treats the field as optional.
- `name` (String) Configuration key to set in the resource Dynamic object.
- `type` (String) Graylog field type (e.g. text, number, boolean, dropdown, list, string).
